g.text: Entry points
External
Core
State
cli.js and index.js · upstream entry, untouched by the fork
branch alertme · five commits ahead of master, which stays at 1.33.2
data/configuration.yaml · frontend true, spg900.js listed as an external converter
Koenkk/zigbee2mqtt · 1.33.2, the base this fork tracks
zigbee-herdsman-alertme · package.json depends on the git URL, branch alertme
MQTT broker · every device state and command goes through it
Home Assistant · discovery is switched off in this config
data/spg900.js · 597-line external converter, the whole point of the fork
fromZigbee · alertmeSwitchState, alertmePowerUsage, alertmeJoin, alertmeDeviceGeneral
toZigbee · state on or off becomes setSwitchState with the relay mask
six radio modes · normal, range test, locked, seeking, idle, dormant
fingerprint · matches the plug before the generic converters get a look
src/ · upstream coordinator, MQTT and frontend code, no other edits
data/state.json · cache_state false but persistent true, so state survives restarts
data/database.db · coordinator and device pairing, upstream behaviour
configuration.yaml · edited in the repo, so a deploy has to keep or re-apply it
package-lock.json · two lines changed, the herdsman git reference
